presets.title: Presets
presets.taiwan-standard: 底100 台20, 16 rotations, normal speed. The default club game.
presets.small: 底50 台10. Same rules, gentler score swings.
presets.big: 底300 台100. Every 台 matters.
presets.turbo: 7-second turns with a 10-second bank, 8 rotations. Lunch-break mahjong.
presets.beginner: Relaxed clock, 台 capped at 8, 4 rotations.
presets.purist: 過水 on: pass on a winning discard and you must draw before winning again. One winner per discard.
presets.party: 一炮多響 on, 無花 1 台, fast speed.

speed: Speed (seconds per move + time bank per hand)
dealerStreakTai: Dealer streak 台 per 連莊
multipleWinners: Multiple winners on one discard (一炮多響)
passRule: 過水 (pass on a win → no ron until next draw)

network.title: Network (development builds)
network.body: Game server for online tables and clubs. Leave empty to use this build's server (%{url}). Release builds always use the build's server.

account.title: Account
account.offline: Not connected to the game server yet. Playing online or opening Clubs creates a guest account; signing in keeps it safe across devices.
account.guestBody: Your progress and clubs are tied to this device. Sign in to keep them if you lose or replace it.
account.noProviders: Sign-in with Apple or Google is not available on this server yet.
account.signOutGuestWarning: Signing out deletes nothing on the server, but this guest cannot be recovered afterwards: its progress and clubs will be lost to you. Sign in first to keep them.
account.deleteBody: This removes your account, name and club memberships from the server. Purchase records are kept. Type %{word} to confirm.

legal.title: Legal
legal.body: The terms you play under and how your data is used. You can delete your account under Account above.
